'''Mos Shuuta barracks''' was a barracks in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], near the [[Landing Bay Besh]]. 25 [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] working for [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] lived there.
